measured_source_cues: The island reads as a complete circular radial city before individual buildings.
The outer board ring is nearly the island diameter and encloses the maze.
The central keep is roughly one quarter of the island diameter and three to four maze-wall heights tall.
Dense masonry occupies every quadrant; no broad empty plateau is visible.
Molten channels weave between buildings and converge on a broad front waterfall.
The viewing authority is an elevated front three-quarter, not a low castle portrait.
